Tentative — dates land once the August 2026 calendar is set. Updates on Slack.
:::

Twenty-five meetings across eight modules. Full lecture titles and slides are on the [materials site ↗](https://nipunbatra.github.io/dl-teaching/slides.html).

| Module | Meetings | The question it answers |
|---|:---:|---|
| Foundations | 1–4 | Why these losses, and how do we differentiate a network? |
| Optimization & training | 5–7 | How do we train deep nets reliably and make them generalize? |
| Computer vision | 8–11 | How do locality and hierarchy change the model? |
| Sequences & language | 12–15 | How do models represent and generate ordered data? |
| Transformers | 16–17 | How does attention become a scalable architecture? |
| Representation & multimodal | 18–19 | How can data supervise itself, and how do images meet text? |
| Generative modeling | 20–23 | How do VAEs, GANs, and diffusion generate? |
| Systems & synthesis | 24–25 | How do we serve models efficiently — and what survives the whole course? |

## Assessment through the term

- **Assignment 1** after Optimization · **Assignment 2** after Vision/Sequences · **Assignment 3** after Transformers/Generative.
- **Quiz 1** (~Optimization) · **Quiz 2** (mid-semester, ~Transformers) · **Quiz 3** (end-semester). Best two of three count.

Exact weeks are on the [Deadlines](deadlines.qmd) page.
